Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_MAV_Debug_v1
Objects.description: MAVLink traffic on one serial port, counted since boot: what the vehicle sends and what the receiver sends back

variables.name: rxMsg
variables.description: Messages received by type: HEARTBEAT, ATTITUDE, LOCAL_POSITION_NED, PARAM_EXT_REQUEST_LIST, any other

variables.name: txMsg
variables.description: Messages sent by type: HEARTBEAT, REQUEST_DATA_STREAM, LANDING_TARGET in BODY_FRD, LOCAL_OFFSET_NED and LOCAL_NED, VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE, PARAM_EXT_VALUE

variables.name: otherId
variables.description: Ids of the messages received but not used, the first 8 seen

variables.name: otherCount
variables.description: How many of each otherId were received

variables.name: rxDrops
variables.description: Frames lost to a bad checksum or a sequence gap

variables.name: hbSysId
variables.description: System id of the autopilot's last HEARTBEAT

variables.name: hbCompId
variables.description: Component id of the autopilot's last HEARTBEAT

variables.name: hbType
variables.description: MAV_TYPE in the last HEARTBEAT (2 quadrotor, 1 fixed wing, ...)

variables.name: hbAutopilot
variables.description: MAV_AUTOPILOT in the last HEARTBEAT (3 ArduPilot, 12 PX4)

variables.name: hbBaseMode
variables.description: MAV_MODE_FLAG bits in the last HEARTBEAT (128 armed)

variables.name: hbSystemStatus
variables.description: MAV_STATE in the last HEARTBEAT (4 active)

variables.name: hbMavlinkVersion
variables.description: MAVLink version in the last HEARTBEAT

variables.name: hbCustomMode
variables.description: Autopilot-specific flight mode in the last HEARTBEAT

variables.name: ltBodyFrd
variables.description: Last LANDING_TARGET sent in MAV_FRAME_BODY_FRD (x, y, z)

variables.name: ltOffsetNed
variables.description: Last LANDING_TARGET sent in MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_OFFSET_NED (x, y, z)

variables.name: ltLocalNed
variables.description: Last LANDING_TARGET sent in MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_NED (x, y, z)
